subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Chlorotris(triphenylphosphine)cobalt（CoCl(PPh₃)₃）？
A. Tetrahedral
B. Square planar
C. Trigonal prismatic
D. Trigonal planar
explanation: Tetrahedral. Covalent count: Co (group 9) 9 e; 1 × Cl (X) 1 e; 3 × PPh₃ (L) 6 e: 16 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −1 in all and the complex is neutral, so the metal is Co(I), d⁸; d⁸ + 8 e from the ligands = 16 e.
